_comment: Seed template for a new project's .ai_ide_permissions.json. Copied in once by open_project() when a project has no permissions file of its own yet -- editing the PROJECT's own copy afterward is what actually takes effect; this global file is only the starting point for new/unconfigured projects. See backend/project_permissions.py for the enforcement logic and rule precedence.

terminal._comment_deny: Dangerous command denylist — hard-blocked in ALL modes, never queued for approval.
terminal._comment_reads: Read-only query commands — auto-run even when Terminal writes are OFF (cannot cause harm). Everything else that isn't denied flows through the approval layer.
